title: GuardPolicy
description: A customer's guard policy (docs/GUARD.md section 3), written in YAML (the strict subset bin/lib/yaml-lite.mjs reads) or JSON. The guard refuses unknown keys, wrong types, duplicate rule ids, on_fail deny without absolute, and allow for source_unreachable or failMode. The policy's sha256 is the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the document as parsed.

version.description: The policy's version number; raise it on every change.

description.description: Free text for people; the guard never reads it.

applies_to.description: Which actions are checked. Everything else passes straight through.

host_from.description: Typed argument fields (dotted paths allowed) the target host is read from, in order. Default: url, endpoint, host, domain, base_url, webhook_url, email, to.

log.description: What the guard needs from Trooth's log. Default: required true, min_witnesses 1.

rules.description: The rules, each tested against signed, logged facts. Rule ids are unique.

destinations.description: Hosts for CI mode (trooth guard ci).

unknown_counterparty.description: The decision when no Trooth record exists for the host. Default hold.

source_unreachable.description: The decision when no Trooth source answers and no cached bundle is held. Default hold. allow is refused.

appliesTo.title: GuardAppliesTo
appliesTo.description: The tools and HTTP destinations the policy covers.

tools.description: Tool names; "*" stands for any run of characters (mcp__bank__*).

http.description: For the http adapter: methods and host patterns whose requests are checked.

httpTarget.title: GuardHttpTarget
httpTarget.description: One method and host pattern (an exact host, or *. followed by a domain of at least two labels).

method.description: The HTTP method, or * for any.

logRequirement.title: GuardLogRequirement
logRequirement.description: Log inclusion and witness cosignatures the policy asks for.

required.description: Whether a statement must be shown in the log (hold NOT_IN_LOG otherwise). A failed proof denies either way.

min_witnesses.description: How many pinned witnesses must have cosigned a checkpoint covering the statement.

rule.title: GuardRule
rule.description: One rule. A claim missing, stale or disputed holds; a rule marked absolute that fails denies.

id.description: The rule's id, unique in the policy.

description.description: Free text for people; the guard never reads it.

require.description: A claim with an optional maximum age, or a valid signature by a key in an accepted state.

on_fail.description: hold (default), or deny for a rule marked absolute.

absolute.description: When true, the rule failing denies the action (ABSOLUTE_RULE_FAILED).

claimRequire.title: GuardClaimRequire
claimRequire.description: A claim read from a signed, logged Trooth artifact.

claim.description: trooth_reading, check:<check_id>, legal_entity_registry_record, no_sanctions_name_match, no_sam_exclusion_name_match, domain_registration_record, security_txt_published, or domain_control_confirmed (since trooth 0.14.0, from a confirmed proof in the signed public record binding the domain to the company record or to its declaration key).

max_age_days.description: The oldest observation the rule accepts, in days. Default: the evidence class's stale-after.

signatureRequire.title: GuardSignatureRequire
signatureRequire.description: A valid signature by a key in one of the accepted states at signing time.

destinations.title: GuardDestinations
destinations.description: For CI mode: hosts a build may add, and the hosts to watch.

allowed.description: Host patterns a build may add without failing.

watch.description: Host patterns CI mode reports when added and not allowed. Default (empty): every new external host.
